title: Design or evolve SIMAI Framework Components and Smart Components from real scenarios
workflow: Inspect authoritative source, registry, tests, distribution and current documentation before proposing changes.
Define the component essence, layer boundary, non-goals and practical scenario matrix.

Design the target semantic, behavioral, visual, adaptation and compatibility contract, including a token map, surface geometry matrix, Component structure map, public data-attribute contract, state geometry matrix, focus contract and an indicator semantics contract when state indicators are present.
Compare current and target contracts with keep, fix, add, deprecate and defer decisions.
Implement and verify the base Component before projecting data, state and effects into a Smart Component.
Update live examples, documentation and machine contracts from the verified source implementation.
Run browser, accessibility, responsive, theme and visual-coherence acceptance, then record technology quality feedback.
